setting.en: The bus station in Koper on a Saturday morning. You want to spend the day in Piran and come back in the evening. You go to the ticket counter: which ticket, when, from which platform, and when is the last bus back?
setting.de: Der Busbahnhof in Koper an einem Samstagmorgen. Du möchtest den Tag in Piran verbringen und am Abend zurückkommen. Du gehst zum Schalter: welche Fahrkarte, wann, von welchem Bussteig, und wann fährt der letzte Bus zurück?
setting.it: La stazione degli autobus di Capodistria, un sabato mattina. Vuoi passare la giornata a Pirano e tornare la sera. Vai allo sportello: quale biglietto, a che ora, da quale corsia, e quando parte l'ultimo autobus per il ritorno?

role: Prodajalka Sonja, the ticket seller at Koper bus station. Quick, patient with foreigners. A return to Piran is five euros, cash or card; the next bus leaves in twenty minutes from platform 3, the ride is forty minutes, no change; the last bus back is at nine in the evening. Says vi.
